conclusion: Conditionally feasible in a narrower declared deterministic finite domain; preferable to silently rebuilding unknown history from the current snapshot. Coverage of all native states is not yet proved, so there is not yet an online prediction certificate.
construction: Retain the full conditional model event state generated from the deciding owner's lawful initial context and the declared physical/communication contract. Own actually submitted immutable payloads and retry history constrain the prefix; peer private payloads are never read.

Before A first_return, the closed vocabulary has at most8 initial-route/E-window action prefixes. Before B first_reuse_route it has at most16 prefixes including the earlier return alternative. These are action-prefix counts, not proven counts of every possible hidden native state.

For every still-possible prefix, stop before consuming the current undecided suffix, then compare only facts actually available to this owner: supplied capture/current view, observed entry and terminal receipts, exact own request/ACK history and delivered peer messages. Do not compare future raw outcomes or the peer's own endpoint.

Native request and publication identities must keep a persistent one-to-one alias relation to the simulated operations. Actual IDs, retries, source/channel/publication sequence, payload and causal times are validated at the native adapter first. An alpha-renaming comparison is allowed only for model-generated symbolic IDs; it cannot erase duplicate IDs, changed retries or missing messages.

Keep every noncontradicted state. Equal visible snapshots alone do not justify merging. Merge only after complete dynamic-state equivalence, preserving internal aliases, relative event order, queue/calendar/headway, pending timers, owner notification/communication/reply budgets and all action obligations; otherwise evaluate each remaining state.

A candidate is conditionally protected only if every retained state has a complete known candidate and matched-baseline projection, with every protected job delta<=0 in that same state. Any unsupported state or projection makes the candidate unknown. No most-likely choice, averaging, probability prior, tolerance or guessed single peer state is used.
coverage_obligations_before_use: Prove the initial model state covers the actual fixture's initial hidden calendars/queues/policy phases, not merely its visible rows. The prior96 output conformance is regression evidence and does not itself prove this invariant.

Show that public policy and exogenous contracts restrict every possible earlier physical action to the declared prefix vocabulary, including native_default autonomous choices, rejection/recovery and the sole fresh pair. A changed peer policy, extra command, missing history, unknown fault or ambiguous event ordering outside this set returns unknown.

Explain how the exact event transition and observation models preserve coverage at each update. If unseen native sequence/headway/peer controller choices can produce additional states, explicitly represent them or reject the domain; action enumeration alone is not sufficient.
Actual owner/current/action/ACK-union/delivery/expiry/wire guards remain independent mandatory gates. A retained model state never becomes a NativeCollected capability or a native checkpoint.
Actual subsequent message agreement only filters model states; it cannot retroactively authenticate predicted captures or fill a missing actual completion receipt.

smallest_next_gate.source_only_first: Implement a support/coverage inventory and a pause-before-decision interface in separate files, without an optimizer. Prove the suffix is not consumed before pause and cloned model aliases remain internal.
smallest_next_gate.bounded_saved_trial_after_review: Use all192 actual successful later collections as observation targets and all34 failed first attempts as mandatory guard negatives. Count all retained/rejected/unsupported prefixes for every case/phase. First check that the actual known prefix is not incorrectly rejected; do not use its saved action label to select or initialize the belief.
smallest_next_gate.no_shortcut: Raw case/branch labels and native final endpoints remain verifier targets only. Do not replay one known actual path and call it an online belief.
smallest_next_gate.fair_cost: All methods receive the same state set and evaluator, logical action ceilings32/4 and explicit state-transition work limit. Prefix construction, filtering, copies, state merging and every candidate-state continuation are fully charged. This may be slower; it is not presently a100ms optimization.

primary_reference.title: Planning and acting in partially observable stochastic domains
primary_reference.authors: Leslie Pack Kaelbling, Michael L. Littman, Anthony R. Cassandra
primary_reference.supported_point: State estimation combines action/observation history with a transition and observation model; selecting only a most probable state is insufficient in general.
primary_reference.application_is_inference: Our proposed set-valued deterministic prefix filter borrows the uncertainty-retention principle. It is not the paper's probabilistic POMDP solver, supplies no probability prior, and imports no single-agent optimality theorem into the two-owner protocol. The paper does not establish our finite action/state coverage or physical protection.
